name: college-admission-agent
description: FastAPI + FastMCP service that predicts graduate school admission chances using a watsonx.ai online deployment endpoint.

IBM_CLOUD_API_KEY.description: IBM Cloud API key used to obtain an IAM bearer token for calling the watsonx.ai deployment endpoint.

WATSONX_DEPLOYMENT_URL.description: Full URL to the watsonx.ai deployment predictions endpoint (region + deployment ID + version query param).
